name: Curt Bergfors Foundation (Food Planet Prize)
collect_note: Page watch only: the Food Planet Prize is an annual award, not a grant call. Nominations are accepted year-round through the website form with no published deadline (the page advises nominating before May for the following year's cycle, which is guidance, not a dated call), and the funder publishes no open call list. Its only dated items are longlists and shortlists of already-nominated initiatives, which are not calls and are not collected; the nominations-coordinator job listings and press releases are not calls either. Change watch on the prize page catches a new nomination window or a changed process.
